answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The mirror of work and the onyx of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a wander to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
